database_limit: Commander Spellbook is incomplete, especially for new cards. No-match records are evidence, not proof of absence.
notes: All ten exact current lists have full-list Commander Spellbook scans plus manual prerequisite review. Six unchanged lists retain their hash-current 2026-08-30 scans; Aragorn, Frodo and Sam, Gandalf, and the changed Minn list were scanned and reviewed on 2026-09-01.

decks.summary: The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Annie Joins Up and Roaming Throne can multiply Aragorn triggers, and Jeskai Ascendancy repeatedly untaps Bloom Tender, Faeburrow Elder, and the other mana creatures. Manual review found no repeatable spell, buyback engine, or creature recast loop to turn those engines into a deterministic cycle; all current multicolor-spell and token sequences are finite.

The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Manual review found no loop among Selvala, Devoted Druid, Pip-Boy 3000, Bear Umbra, or the Equipment-copy package; the deck's sharp finishes remain finite commander-damage attacks.
The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Free Equipment movement, token doubling, and Bloodforged Battle-Axe scaling are strong but finite in the current 100.

The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Peregrin Took, Rosie Cotton, Samwise Gamgee, Mirkwood Bats, and the Food engines scale together, but manual review found no repeatable token-conversion or zero-cost historic recursion engine. Prize Pig can untap after life gain, yet Food activations still consume mana and tokens, so no current deterministic loop was found.

The exact-list scan returned and manual review confirmed the conditional Surge to Victory plus Savage Beating unlimited-combat line. Surge must exile Savage Beating from the graveyard, and a creature must keep connecting; each hit casts a Savage Beating copy for another untap and combat. World at War and the remaining Wizard trigger-copy sequences are finite outside that line.

lines.reason: Cast Surge to Victory with Savage Beating in the graveyard. When a creature connects, the Surge trigger casts Savage Beating's extra-combat mode; repeat while a creature can continue dealing combat damage to an opponent.

decks.summary: Commander Spellbook returned the Mikaeus and Viscera Seer template, but the exact list has no qualifying persist creature. Manual review of the death, blitz, and reanimation package found no replacement that closes the loop.

lines.reason: No creature with persist is present in the current 100.

decks.summary: The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Dwarven Bloodboiler, Relic of Legends, crew effects, Maskwood Nexus, and Roaming Throne create or double a finite number of Magda triggers because the deck has no repeatable untap engine.

The exact-list scan returned no included combo. The refreshed list still has Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, and Blasting Station, but manual review found no effect that returns a sacrificed Illusion or recreates a token from the sacrifice itself. Draw doublers increase Minn triggers while Teferi's ultimate is a distant two-extra-turn finisher; the current 100 has no complete sacrifice, draw, or extra-turn loop.

All three returned Apex Altisaur and Wrathful Raptors lines are present. They clear opposing creatures and can deal near-infinite damage when opposing bodies keep Apex Altisaur's fight chain going; Savage Order is the compact tutored version and is the list's main Bracket 3 disclosure.

Commander Spellbook returned the finite Fire Covenant and Brash Taunter kill. Manual review also found a real but expensive five-card Arcbond loop: copy Arcbond onto Selfless Squire, make both it and Brash Taunter indestructible, then have Brash fight the Squire. The two delayed triggers feed each other while the Squire prevents damage to you.

lines.reason: Copy Arcbond so Brash Taunter and Selfless Squire each have its delayed trigger, give both indestructible, and activate Brash Taunter to fight the Squire. Each Arcbond trigger damages the other creature and creates the next trigger; Selfless Squire prevents the damage to you while opponents take every iteration.
